Zimbabwe defeats Bangladesh in Harare Test, impacting WTC standings

Zimbabwe secured a significant victory over Bangladesh in the Harare Test, winning by an innings and 85 runs. This result has implications for the World Test Championship (WTC) standings, with Bangladesh's position affected. The win marks Zimbabwe's largest ever in the WTC.
